title: Courier
description: Small mail mod centered around delivery and finding your friends without the locator bar!
body:
# **Courier**
### **A small Minecraft mail mod for multiplayer servers**

## **Items:**
### - **Copper Compass:**
Right-click to link. After linking right-click by an other player. When held in inventory by one of the linked players, it will point to the other linked player
### - **Script:**
Right-click to write and sign. Right-click a wrapping table to wrap
### - **Wrapped Script:**
Right-click a pigeon to give it to them. The pigeon will deliver the message to the signed player
### - **Package:**
Right-click items into the package, shift-right-click to dump everything out. Sign by right-clicking on a Wrapping Table. Pigeons deliver the signed packages

## **Blocks:**
### - **Wrapper Table:**
Shift-right-click to call back tamed pigeons, used for wrapping
### - **Mailbox:**
If the signed player is not online, the pigeon will place the package or script into the mailbox the player placed

## **Pigeons**
Tamed with seeds, 4 available variants
